what_it_does: xGFabric is a complete system that connects field sensors (like agricultural monitoring devices) spread across farmland to high-performance supercomputers for real-time digital agriculture applications. The challenge is that sensor networks send data slowly and unreliably, while supercomputers process data very quickly but are far away, creating high communication delays. xGFabric bridges this gap using Private 5G wireless networks—slicing the network into dedicated channels that guarantee both low latency for sensor data and high throughput for HPC results, making real-time scientific decision-making possible.
